definitions.title: Reward
definitions.text: It’s the money you get at the end of a mission, before paying your fees. It’s not what you actually have left.

definitions.title: Earnings, or profit
definitions.text: It’s what you have left once your fees are paid. Reward $100,000, fees $20,000: your earnings are $80,000.

definitions.title: ROI: what a purchase earns you, in %
definitions.text: It’s what a purchase has earned you, as a percentage of its price: earned in the end ÷ price × 100. 0% means paid back; 100% means it earned twice its price.

definitions.title: Payback, or “paid back”
definitions.text: It’s the point when a purchase has earned you as much as it cost. In “Is it worth it?”, the calculator tells you after how many hours of play you get there.

definitions.title: Return
definitions.text: It’s what a sum you spend earns you over a given period. An amount per hour of play isn’t a return: you also need to say how long you use it.

definitions.title: Money set aside (reserve)
definitions.text: It’s the part of your money you don’t want to spend. The calculator never touches it: for your purchases, it acts as if that money didn’t exist.

faq.text: The site may not have any verified economic data for this page yet. You can run a clearly named personal simulation, or wait for official info. The edition’s retail price in euros isn’t the item’s in-game price in dollars.
The mode changes what you’re shown, not the calculation. Expert lets you change extra settings; going back to Simple doesn’t erase them.
Check its duration with prep, the fees to pay first, the players needed, and the checked activities. An activity only pays once it’s finished.

“I already have”, the money set aside, your purchases, and your activities are the same everywhere. Changing a purchase’s price also changes your budget, your buying order, and “Is it worth it?” Save a copy to compare two versions.

My business plan starts from a goal (a purchase or an amount) and your numbers, then gives you the order of the steps and the play time needed. My progress tracks items you check off on the site. Neither of them reads a save from your console.

On the Progress page, export your progress. On the other device, import that file, read the preview, then choose Merge or Replace for the sections in the file. Older compatible saves are migrated; unknown references are flagged.
The site follows your device’s reduced motion setting. Answers and steps are visible right away. Screenshots are still images, and the highlighted zones can be read without animation.

knowledge.q: When does GTA VI come out?
knowledge.text: GTA VI comes out on Thursday, November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. That’s the date Rockstar announced on November 6, 2025, after two delays.

knowledge.q: Has GTA VI been delayed?
knowledge.text: The game has been delayed twice: first from 2025 to May 26, 2026 (announced on May 2, 2025), then to November 19, 2026 (announced on November 6, 2025). Rockstar said it wants to deliver the game at the level of quality people expect. No new delay has been announced.

knowledge.q: What time will GTA VI be available on release day?
knowledge.text: On the PlayStation Store, the game unlocks at midnight on the night of November 18 to 19, 2026 (local time). Check the exact time on your console’s store right before, since it can change.

knowledge.q: When does GTA VI preloading start?
knowledge.text: Preloading starts on November 12, 2026 for digital versions, one week before release. The game’s file size hasn’t been announced.

knowledge.q: How big is GTA VI (GB)?
knowledge.text: Rockstar hasn’t shared the game’s file size. We’ll know the exact size when preloading opens, on November 12, 2026.

knowledge.q: Which consoles is GTA VI coming out on?
knowledge.text: At launch, GTA VI is planned for PlayStation 5 (including PS5 Pro) and Xbox Series X|S only. No other platform has been announced for November 19, 2026.

knowledge.q: Will GTA VI come out on PC?
knowledge.text: No PC version has been announced: no date, no Steam page. A rumor from September 2026 talks about it arriving “earlier than usual”, but Rockstar hasn’t confirmed anything. For GTA V, the PC version came out a year and a half after the console versions.

knowledge.q: Will GTA VI come out on PS4, Xbox One or Switch?
knowledge.text: No: GTA VI isn’t planned for PS4, Xbox One or Nintendo Switch 2. Only PS5 and Xbox Series X|S have been announced.

knowledge.q: Does GTA VI run at 60 fps or in 4K on PS5 Pro?
knowledge.text: The game is announced as “PS5 Pro Enhanced”. Rockstar hasn’t published any details on resolution or frame rate. The August 27, 2026 Extended Look was captured on PS5.

knowledge.q: Will GTA VI have crossplay between consoles?
knowledge.text: Nothing has been announced about cross-platform play: for now, there’s no announcement at all about GTA VI’s online mode.

knowledge.q: How much does GTA VI cost?
knowledge.text: In stores, the Standard Edition is listed at €79.99 and the Ultimate Edition at €99.99 (upgrading from one to the other: about €20). These are the prices seen since pre-orders opened on June 25, 2026; check your store.

knowledge.q: What are the editions of GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Two editions: Standard (the game) and Ultimate, which adds a collection of vehicles, weapons, clothing and content tied to Jason and Lucia’s story. On the site, the content already described is listed in “Everything you can buy”, “Clothing and style” and “Customization”.

knowledge.q: What’s in the Ultimate Edition?
knowledge.text: Based on the official presentations already covered on the site: a retro kit for Jason’s Ganado (Rideout Customs), the “Vice City Style” and “Goodtime Gear” collections, the Paradise garage with the Dominator Buggy, and services at Sara’s Unisex Salon, Stock 305 and Electric Fang Tattoo. The in-game prices of this content aren’t published.

knowledge.q: Where can I pre-order GTA VI and what’s the bonus?
knowledge.text: Pre-orders have been open since June 25, 2026 on the PlayStation Store, the Xbox Store and the Rockstar Store. The pre-order bonus (before November 20, 2026) is the Vintage Vice City Pack: ’80s outfits, a weapon pattern and the Stanier ’55 with the Shore Court garage.

links.label: The Vintage Vice City Pack on the site

knowledge.q: What’s the Vintage Vice City Pack?
knowledge.text: The Vintage Vice City Pack is the pre-order bonus: a retro outfit and hairstyle for Jason, a sequin dress and curly hair for Lucia, a tropical pattern for weapons, and the Vapid Stanier ’55 parked in a garage in Shore Court, near Ocean Beach.

knowledge.q: Is GTA+ included with GTA VI?
knowledge.text: A digital pre-order made before November 20, 2026 gives you a month of GTA+. According to Rockstar Support, that month is for today’s GTA Online, the one from GTA V: to activate before March 31, 2027 on PS5, or within 180 days on Xbox, then renewed at the regular price unless you cancel it. Nothing is said about GTA+ in GTA VI.

knowledge.q: Is GTA VI available as a physical copy (boxed)?
knowledge.text: A boxed version is sold, but according to store listings it contains a download code rather than a disc. Check what the box says before buying if it matters to you.

knowledge.q: When was GTA VI announced?
knowledge.text: Rockstar confirmed GTA VI was in development on February 4, 2022, in a post on its website. The first trailer came out on December 4, 2023.

knowledge.q: What does GTA VI Trailer 1 show?
knowledge.text: Trailer 1 came out on December 4, 2023, a day earlier than planned after a leak. It introduces Lucia, Leonida and Vice City, set to Tom Petty’s “Love Is a Long Road”. It passed 90 million views in 24 hours.

knowledge.q: What does GTA VI Trailer 2 show?
knowledge.text: Trailer 2 came out on May 6, 2025, along with the first screenshots and the introductions of Jason, Lucia and the other characters. The song is “Hot Together” by the Pointer Sisters.

knowledge.q: What’s the GTA VI Extended Look?
knowledge.text: The Extended Look is a presentation of about 26 minutes that aired on August 27, 2026, first on Netflix and then on YouTube. Captured on PS5, it shows car theft, store robberies, the police, the game’s social media and Jason and Lucia’s everyday life.

knowledge.q: Will there be a GTA VI Trailer 3?
knowledge.text: No Trailer 3 has been announced. The latest official video is the Extended Look from August 27, 2026.

knowledge.q: What’s the music in the GTA VI trailers?
knowledge.text: Trailer 1: “Love Is a Long Road” by Tom Petty. Trailer 2: “Hot Together” by the Pointer Sisters, with short car radio snippets (Zenglen, Wang Chung, Tammy Wynette). The Extended Look features fourteen more songs, from Phil Collins to Depeche Mode. The full list, with timings and sources, is in the radio player on the Radio and music page.
knowledge.status: Official Rockstar info (trailers) · press findings (Extended Look)

knowledge.q: Who is developing GTA VI?
knowledge.text: GTA VI is developed by Rockstar Games (led by Rockstar North, with the group’s other studios) and published by Take-Two Interactive, on the in-house RAGE engine.

knowledge.q: How much did GTA VI cost to develop?
knowledge.text: Rockstar and Take-Two have never published GTA VI’s budget. The numbers going around (one or two billion dollars) are press estimates, not official information.

knowledge.q: Is there any info on GTA 7?
knowledge.text: There’s nothing on a GTA VII: GTA VI isn’t even out yet.

knowledge.q: Who are the main characters in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: You play two characters: Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, a duo who have to trust each other in a State of Leonida where anything can go wrong. You switch between them as the story goes on, like in GTA V.

knowledge.q: Who is Lucia Caminos?
knowledge.text: Lucia Caminos is one of the two playable characters. Her father taught her to fight; fighting for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary. Fresh out, she only wants to make smart moves from now on. She’s the first female lead in the series.

knowledge.q: Who is Jason Duval?
knowledge.text: Jason Duval is the other playable character: ex-military and raised among grifters, he works for the drug runners in the Keys. He’d like an easy life; meeting Lucia is going to complicate everything.

knowledge.q: Which characters are in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Rockstar has introduced eight characters: Jason Duval, Lucia Caminos, Cal Hampton, Boobie Ike, Dre’Quan Priest, Real Dimez (Bae-Luxe and Roxy), Raul Bautista and Brian Heder. Each one has a page on the site.

knowledge.q: What is GTA VI’s story about?
knowledge.text: Rockstar describes Jason and Lucia as two people who only have each other in a state where anything can go wrong: a job gone bad, the police, the drug runners in the Keys and Boobie Ike’s empire in Vice City. The plot details aren’t published.

knowledge.q: Will GTA VI be in French?
knowledge.text: Like every GTA, the voices are in English with subtitles, French included. Rockstar hasn’t announced any dubbing.

knowledge.q: What is Leonida?
knowledge.text: Leonida is the fictional state where the game takes place: a reimagined Florida, with Vice City (inspired by Miami), the Keys, the Grassrivers swamps, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.

knowledge.q: What is Vice City in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Vice City is Leonida’s big city, inspired by Miami: beaches, shopping districts, a cruise port and Downtown’s skyscrapers. Rockstar mentions Ocean Beach, Little Cuba, Tisha-Wocka and VC Port.

knowledge.q: What are the regions of GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Six regions have been announced: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park. The county names seen in official media (Vice-Dale, Kelly, Leonard, Mariana, Ambrosia) come from community findings.

knowledge.q: What are the Leonida Keys?
knowledge.text: The Leonida Keys are a tropical archipelago linked by long roads over the water. Jason lives there on a property owned by Brian Heder, whose boatyard still moves goods.

knowledge.q: What is Grassrivers?
knowledge.text: Grassrivers is Leonida’s vast wilderness: mangroves, slow channels and flooded plains you cross by airboat, with alligators.

knowledge.q: What is Port Gellhorn?
knowledge.text: Port Gellhorn is a former vacation spot living off what’s left of it: cheap motels, empty malls and closed attractions.

knowledge.q: What is Ambrosia?
knowledge.text: Ambrosia is Leonida’s farming and industrial side, built around the Allied Crystal sugar refinery, with a local biker gang.

knowledge.q: What is Mount Kalaga National Park?
knowledge.text: Mount Kalaga National Park is the park in northern Leonida: forests, rivers and muddy trails. Rockstar presents it as a place for hunting, fishing and off-roading.

knowledge.q: How big is the GTA VI map?
knowledge.text: Rockstar hasn’t given the size of the map. It covers six regions, from the city to the swamps. On the site, the interactive map lists about 2,500 places spotted in official media.

knowledge.q: Are there animals in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Yes, more than 170 species, according to Rockstar’s Michael Kane in the Game Informer cover story (September 29, 2026): alligators, manatees, flamingos, pelicans, and invasive species like the green iguana. The official images already show alligators, iguanas, deer, a cougar, dolphins and dogs; in the Extended Look, Jason pets a dog. No pet to adopt has been announced.
knowledge.status: Game Informer cover story with Rockstar, and official images

knowledge.q: Will there be a GTA Online for GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Rockstar hasn’t announced anything yet about GTA VI’s online mode, not even a date: as of October 4, 2026, the game is presented as a single-player experience, out November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Twitch’s boss mentioned multiplayer in 2027, without confirmation from Rockstar. Take-Two says it will keep GTA V’s GTA Online going after the release.
knowledge.status: Official Rockstar and Take-Two info · no online mode announced

knowledge.q: How do the police work in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Rob Nelson (Rockstar North) explained it to IGN and Famitsu: a crime is only reported if someone sees it or an alarm goes off, and the stars go up with how serious it is, without overdoing it. The police know your vehicle and your clothes: glasses, a cap or a haircut aren’t enough, you have to change outfits, at a store or with the one in your personal vehicle’s trunk.

knowledge.q: How do you steal a car in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: The Extended Look shows three ways to steal a car: smash the window, slide a slim jim into older models or clone the key of newer ones. Rob Nelson explains that some cars stay locked until you have the right tools, and that luxury cars have an alarm and a tracker: a fence can deal with those. How much a sale brings in hasn’t been published.
knowledge.status: Seen in the Extended Look, Rob Nelson’s comments

knowledge.q: Can you do heists in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Jason and Lucia can rob restaurants, stores and other businesses, wearing masks. Rob Nelson also mentions jewelry stores and small banks, solo or as a duo, and Trailer 2 shows a masked bank heist. The story’s big heists aren’t detailed.
knowledge.status: Seen in the Extended Look · Rob Nelson’s comments (Famitsu)

knowledge.q: Can you gain weight or build muscle in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Yes. Rob Nelson of Rockstar North confirmed it: what Jason and Lucia eat affects their weight, and exercise visibly builds their muscles. There are gyms where you train to build muscle and strength; the Extended Look shows Lucia on the bench press. No numbers have been published.

knowledge.q: Are there consumables (eating, drinking, healing) in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Eating, drinking or healing restores health in GTA games; the first aid kit and body armor are described in the GTA VI Armory. No items or prices have been published so far.

knowledge.q: Is there social media and a phone in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: The game has a social media feed (Snapmatic) where you scroll through posts from characters and contacts, seen in the Extended Look. Details on the phone aren’t published.

knowledge.q: What radio stations are in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Rockstar hasn’t announced any radio stations yet. On September 17, 2026, when announcing “Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album” (34 original tracks, on November 19, 2026), it promised “the next evolution of in-game radio” and a dynamic score. The logo of V-Rock, the rock station from GTA Vice City, is reportedly visible on Jason’s T-shirt, according to players, but the station isn’t confirmed. The station names going around come from stolen videos from August 2026: the site doesn’t use them.
knowledge.status: Official Rockstar info (album) · no stations announced

knowledge.q: How much do cars, weapons and houses cost in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Rockstar hasn’t published any in-game prices: no cars, no weapons, no houses, no mission payouts. That’s why the site’s calculator asks for your own numbers and always tells you where each value comes from.

knowledge.q: Can you buy businesses or houses in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Nothing is confirmed about buying businesses, houses or apartments in GTA VI. The businesses and residences Rockstar has shown are on the site with their status, and the calculator lets you test your purchase idea with a price you imagine.

knowledge.q: How many weapons are there in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: The site lists 27 weapons identified in official media, five of them named by Rockstar (Jason’s Girardi ES9, Lucia’s Klose K17, the Hawk & Little Morgan…). The Armory also explains the loadout builder, gadgets and ammo.

knowledge.q: Where can you buy ammo in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: The ammo types (pistol, shells, rifle, etc.) and the gear (bag, vest, first aid kit) are described in the site’s Armory. Their price in GTA VI isn’t published.

knowledge.q: How many vehicles are in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: The site lists 302 vehicles seen in official media (cars, motorcycles, boats, planes, helicopters), with each one’s brand, category and real-world inspiration. Rockstar hasn’t published any official list.

knowledge.q: Can you customize your car in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Rideout Customs (classic cars) and One-Eyed Willie’s (off-road) are the shops Rockstar has shown. A retro kit for the Ganado and a weapon pattern are described with the editions. Prices aren’t published.

knowledge.q: Can you buy clothes in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: The “Clothing and style” page brings together four sections: outfits, accessories, tattoos (Electric Fang Tattoo) and hairstyles (Sara’s Unisex Salon), with the announced collections. No item has a published price.

knowledge.q: Are there boats in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Yes: the site lists boats seen in media, and Rockstar describes getting the Crest Kayak and the Shitzu Squalo with the Ultimate Edition. In-game prices aren’t published.
knowledge.status: Official (how to get them) · identification (the rest)

knowledge.q: Can you fly planes and helicopters in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: The site lists planes and helicopters identified in official media, plus the Vice City airport. Rockstar hasn’t detailed how flying works.

knowledge.q: What’s the minimum age (PEGI) for GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Like every GTA, GTA VI is meant for adults: a PEGI 18 rating is expected in Europe. The official rating will be shown on the store.

knowledge.q: Will there be mods or cheat codes in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Rockstar hasn’t announced anything about mods or cheat codes for GTA VI (as of October 4, 2026), and the “GTA 6” lists going around aren’t official. In GTA V, codes were entered with the controller, on the in-game phone or, on PC, in the console; Rockstar specifies that they disabled achievements for a while.
knowledge.status: Not announced · GTA V rules published by Rockstar

knowledge.q: Will GTA VI be in virtual reality?
knowledge.text: No virtual reality version has been announced.

knowledge.q: Is it the same Vice City as GTA Vice City (2002)?
knowledge.text: It’s the same city, but in the present day: GTA Vice City (2002) was set in 1986. The Vintage Vice City Pack nods to the ’80s with a pattern inspired by Tommy Vercetti’s shirt.

knowledge.q: What’s new in GTA VI compared to GTA V?
knowledge.text: What we’ve seen that’s new: two characters who have to trust each other, an in-game social network, police who recognize your vehicle and outfit, several ways to steal a car, weight that changes with what you eat, and a two-part gear wheel. Rockstar hasn’t published a full list of what’s new.

knowledge.q: What is Leonidakit and who made it?
knowledge.text: Leonidakit is an independent site made by a player, free and with no account needed. It’s not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar or Take-Two. I’m Léo: I answer with the site’s data and simple rules, without sending your questions anywhere.

knowledge.q: Where does the site’s data come from?
knowledge.text: Everything comes from Rockstar’s official presentations (trailers, screenshots, Extended Look, edition pages) and from community findings labeled as such. Nothing comes from leaks. Every page shows its source and its confirmation level.

knowledge.q: How do I report a mistake on the site?
knowledge.text: Use the Contact page: you enter the page, the problem, the fix and a source, then you send the message (it goes through Brevo to the publisher’s inbox, with a reference number). If sending fails, the page gives you the address and the text, ready for your email app.

knowledge.q: How do I track my progress on the site?
knowledge.text: The Progress page is your dashboard: one tracker per category (garage, arsenal, wardrobe, consumables, customizations, properties, spotted places, collectibles, calculations), each with its own page. Everything stays on your device, no account needed, and you can export or import your save as JSON.

knowledge.q: Is the site free, with no account needed?
knowledge.text: The site is free and needs no account. Your calculations and your progress stay in your browser.

knowledge.q: Léo, what can you do?
knowledge.text: I answer questions about GTA VI (release, consoles, price, editions, trailers, characters, regions, what the Extended Look shows), I find the site’s pages (vehicles, weapons, places, characters, businesses), I explain the calculator’s terms and I set up a calculation with your numbers. I’m not a general-purpose AI: if I don’t know, I say so.

knowledge.q: Who is Brian Heder?
knowledge.text: Brian Heder is an old-school drug runner from the Keys; he still moves product through his boatyard with Lori, his third wife, and puts Jason up in exchange for a few favors.

knowledge.q: Who is Boobie Ike?
knowledge.text: Boobie Ike is a Vice City legend who turned his street years into a legit empire (real estate, the Jack of Hearts club, the Only Raw Records label with Dre’Quan Priest, who signed Real Dimez). Raul Bautista is a seasoned robber, and Cal Hampton is Jason’s paranoid friend.

knowledge.q: Is GTA VI’s release date final?
knowledge.text: Rockstar and Take-Two confirmed the November 19, 2026 date several times in 2026, and pre-orders are open. No new delay has been announced, but nobody can guarantee it before launch day.

knowledge.q: Will GTA VI come out on PS6?
knowledge.text: No version for a future console has been announced. At launch, it’s PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

knowledge.q: Does GTA VI have a single-player story mode, and how long is it?
knowledge.text: GTA VI has a story mode with Jason and Lucia. knowledge.q: Who is Cal Hampton?
knowledge.text: Cal Hampton is Jason’s friend and Brian’s associate, in the Keys. He feels safest at home, listening in on Coast Guard comms with a few beers and some private browsing tabs open. He sees conspiracies everywhere. His page is on the site.

knowledge.q: Who is Dre’Quan Priest?
knowledge.text: Dre’Quan Priest is more hustler than gangster: he always had his sights set on music. He signed Real Dimez, teamed up with Boobie Ike on the Only Raw Records label and plans to take over the whole Vice City scene. His page is on the site.

knowledge.q: Who are Real Dimez?
knowledge.text: Real Dimez is Bae-Luxe and Roxy, friends since high school, who turned their hustles into rap tracks and a nonstop online presence. A first hit with the rapper DWNPLY launched them; they’re signed to Only Raw Records. Their page is on the site.

knowledge.q: Who is Raul Bautista?
knowledge.text: Raul Bautista is a seasoned bank robber: confidence, charm and cunning. He recruits partners ready to take the risks that pay off the most, and his recklessness raises the stakes with every job. His page is on the site.

knowledge.q: Where does Jason live?
knowledge.text: Jason lives in the Leonida Keys, in Key Lento, in a stilt house owned by Brian Heder, who lets him stay there rent-free. Rockstar calls it “Jason’s Safehouse” in its official gallery; the Ganado ’70, the Dinka Enduro and the Crest kayak are parked out front. The marker is on the map.

knowledge.q: How much does Jason’s house cost?
knowledge.text: No price is known: Jason’s house belongs to Brian Heder, who lets him stay there rent-free, and Rockstar hasn’t published any housing prices for GTA VI. On the site, the page says exactly what we know. If you want to test a purchase with a price you imagine, the calculator does it with your own numbers.

knowledge.q: Where does Lucia live?

knowledge.q: What vehicles does Jason have?

knowledge.q: What is Jason’s weapon?
knowledge.text: Jason’s personal pistol is the Girardi ES9, named by Rockstar in the Ultimate Edition presentation, which includes an engraved version of it. It’s inspired by the Beretta 92FS. Its page is in the site’s Armory.

knowledge.q: What is Lucia’s weapon?
knowledge.text: Lucia’s pistol is the Klose K17, named by Rockstar with the Ultimate Edition, which includes an engraved version of it. Its page is in the site’s Armory, with its real-world inspiration and its category.

knowledge.q: Are Jason and Lucia a couple?
knowledge.text: It’s up to you: according to the characters FAQ, Rob Nelson told IGN the romance is optional. Its effects on the game haven’t been detailed. Rockstar describes Jason and Lucia as two people who only have each other.

knowledge.q: Can you switch characters at any time?
knowledge.text: Not always. According to the characters FAQ, the Extended Look shows a switch from Jason to Lucia mid-chase, but Rob Nelson told Famitsu that the story sometimes picks the character for you. The details of the rules haven’t been published.

knowledge.q: Who voices Lucia and Jason?
knowledge.text: Rockstar hasn’t published anything. According to the characters FAQ, fans name Manni L. Perez for Lucia and Dylan Rourke for Jason; only Stephen Root has confirmed a role, without saying which one. The site presents it as a community identification, not an official fact.

knowledge.q: How many playable characters are in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Two: Jason and Lucia. According to the characters FAQ, Rob Nelson explained in September 2026 that four characters had been considered before the duo. The six other characters shown aren’t announced as playable.

knowledge.q: Where do Brian and Lori live?
knowledge.text: Brian Heder lives in the Keys with Lori, his third wife. His boatyard (Brian’s Boat Works & Marina, readable in the second trailer) is still where his product moves through. Both addresses have a page and a marker on the map.

knowledge.q: Where are the Leonida Keys on the map?

knowledge.q: Is Leonida Florida?
knowledge.text: Leonida is a made-up state inspired by Florida: Vice City echoes Miami, the Keys the Florida Keys, Grassrivers the Everglades. They’re matches, not copies: the places FAQ points this out, and every identified real-world place is marked as such on the map.

knowledge.q: Is the GTA VI map bigger than GTA V’s?
knowledge.text: According to the places FAQ, in late August 2026 Rockstar told the press: about three times the playable area of Red Dead Redemption 2 and twice that of GTA V. No area figure has been published.

knowledge.q: Can you go everywhere from the start of GTA VI?
knowledge.text: We don’t know. According to the places FAQ, Rockstar hasn’t said anything about areas locked at the start; the area limited by Lucia’s ankle monitor is a player theory, not official info.

knowledge.q: How does the site’s map work?
knowledge.text: The Leonida map shows 2,547 listed places (14 of them named by Rockstar): you move it around, zoom, filter by reliability, source and type, check off what you’ve found, measure a distance between two points with the travel time by vehicle, and add your own markers and drawings. Everything stays on your device.

knowledge.q: How do I measure a distance on the map?
knowledge.text: On the map, open “Measure a distance”: you pick two points (up to 50 waypoints) and get a distance as the crow flies, estimated from the scale of the site’s base map (not game data). No travel time by default: you can show a simulation with GTA V speeds, clearly labeled as such.

knowledge.q: How do I filter the places on the map?
knowledge.text: The map panel has three groups of filters: reliability (Official, Glimpsed, Assumed, with an “Official only” button), the source that revealed the place (official website, trailers, Extended Look, screenshots, community analysis) and the marker type (regions, cities, districts, counties, buildings, transport, nature, notable places, collectibles, safehouses, missions). You can also toggle the base map layers.

knowledge.q: What do Official, Glimpsed and Assumed mean on the map?
knowledge.text: On the map, “Official” means named by Rockstar, “Glimpsed” means seen in a trailer or a screenshot, and “Assumed” means a reconstruction made by the community. The base map itself is provisional: it’s drawn from official material and will be refined after release. None of it comes from leaks.

knowledge.q: Where do the place photos on the map come from?
knowledge.text: The building photos come from GTA VI Landmarks Data and gtadb.org (CC BY 4.0 license), with an official screenshot and, when there is one, a photo of the real-world equivalent. The coastline comes from the same sources, modified for Leonidakit. The credits are at the bottom of the map panel.

knowledge.q: How many places are on the map?
knowledge.text: The map lists 2,547 places, 14 of them named by Rockstar, sorted into 12 categories, and six confirmed regions. Exact locations are only shown if they’re verified and sourced.

knowledge.q: Can I add my own markers on the map?
knowledge.text: Yes. “My markers” lets you drop a point with a name and a note; “Draw” draws lines with a thickness and an opacity. Your markers and drawings stay on your device and are included when you export your progress.

knowledge.q: How do I check off a place I found on the map?
knowledge.text: Click a marker to open it, then check “Mark as spotted”: it goes into your spotted places. The “My spotted places” tracker lists them, along with the ones left and your places to visit. Everything is saved on your device, no account needed.

knowledge.q: What are Leonida’s counties?
knowledge.text: The map shows six counties spotted in official media: Vice-Dale, Kelly, Leonard, Mariana, Lummox and Ambrosia. These are community findings, not a list published by Rockstar: the map shows their certainty level.

knowledge.q: Which places are on the site?
knowledge.text: The Places page brings together the six regions presented by Rockstar (Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga), a dated timeline, sourced fiction / real-world pairs, open questions and a FAQ. The 2,547 specific places are on the map.

knowledge.q: What is the Sahara Arena?
knowledge.text: The Sahara Arena is the Vice City tower and stadium that shows up shot after shot in the trailers, according to the Vice City page. Its marker is on the map, with its official screenshot and its identified real-world equivalent.

knowledge.q: What are Vice City’s districts?
knowledge.text: Rockstar mentions Ocean Beach (art deco hotels and white sand), Little Cuba (its panaderías), Tisha-Wocka and VC Port, plus the Downtown skyscrapers. The Vice City page covers them; the map shows the spotted districts with their certainty level.

knowledge.q: Is the Starlet Motel a safehouse?
knowledge.text: The first trailer’s motel appears in Trailer 1, Trailer 2 and the Extended Look, always with Jason and Lucia. Rockstar has never called it a safehouse: the site files it as “seen in media” and places it on the map thanks to its sign.
knowledge.status: Seen in media · not an official safehouse

knowledge.q: What is the Jack of Hearts?
knowledge.text: The Jack of Hearts is Boobie Ike’s strip club, mentioned on his official character page: the club’s money funds the Only Raw Records studio. It’s seen in Trailer 2 and spotted on the Vice City map.

knowledge.q: Where is Rideout Customs?
knowledge.text: Rideout Customs, the customization shop presented with the Ultimate Edition, is placed on the map in Crosstown (Vice City), based on the official screenshots. I can center the map on it.

knowledge.q: Where are the workshops and gun stores in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: According to the customization FAQ, Rideout Customs is placed on the map in Crosstown (Vice City); One-Eyed Willie’s is at Lake Leonida according to Rockstar, with no confirmed position. The Customization page lists the shops and gun stores with their map thumbnail.

knowledge.q: Can you buy garages in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Yes, according to the safehouses FAQ: Rob Nelson told Famitsu (August 28, 2026) that you start with three vehicle slots and buy garages on the map to get more. No price has been published. The two garages described with the editions (Paradise, Shore Court) each have a page.

knowledge.q: What’s in a personal garage?
knowledge.text: According to the edition texts (June 24, 2026) quoted in the safehouses FAQ: a weapon locker to put your loadout together and a stash to drop stolen goods, which a local fence sells on. The Paradise garage (Ultimate Edition) and the Shore Court one (Vintage Pack) are described that way.

knowledge.q: How many safehouses are in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: No number published. According to the safehouses FAQ, only one address is officially called a safehouse (“Jason’s Safehouse”), and Rob Nelson told Famitsu that you change safehouses as the chapters go by, without buying them. The Safehouses page lists what’s documented.

knowledge.q: Where can you fill up and repair your car?
knowledge.text: At gas stations: according to the businesses FAQ, Rob Nelson said in early September 2026 that filling up takes about ten seconds and that the station does repairs too. To respray, it’s the Pay ’n’ Spray or a workshop.

knowledge.q: Can you rob stores in GTA VI?
knowledge.text: Yes. Trailer 1 already shows Jason and Lucia in a liquor store, and the Extended Look (August 27, 2026) strings together gas station robberies. Rob Nelson tells Famitsu that you rob a store solo or as a pair, that jewelry stores and small banks are better guarded, and that destroying the cameras keeps you from being seen. No loot amounts have been published.
knowledge.status: Rob Nelson’s comments (Famitsu) and official videos

knowledge.q: Which businesses are on the site?
knowledge.text: The Businesses page presents the businesses named by Rockstar: Rideout Customs, Sara’s Unisex Salon, Stock 305, Electric Fang Tattoo, One-Eyed Willie’s, PTT YOUNGIN$, Only Raw Records and the Jack of Hearts, with their status, their map marker when there is one, and a FAQ. None of them is confirmed as buyable.

knowledge.q: Which residences are on the site?
knowledge.text: The Residences page brings together the documented addresses: Jason’s house in the Keys, Cal Hampton’s place, Brian and Lori’s place, and Lucia from prison to Vice City. Each page says what Rockstar shows, with the map marker when there is one.

knowledge.q: Which safehouses are on the site?
knowledge.text: The Safehouses page brings together Jason’s safehouse (the only address Rockstar calls a safehouse), Brian’s boatyard, the first trailer’s motel, and the two garages described with the editions (Paradise in Watson Bay, Shore Court near Ocean Beach), with a FAQ.

knowledge.q: Where can I see all the character pages?
knowledge.text: The Characters page presents the eight characters named by Rockstar, each with their own page (description, facts, linked places and vehicles, official images), a dated timeline, open questions and a FAQ.

knowledge.q: What is the About page for?
knowledge.text: The About page explains why Leonidakit exists (rumors everywhere, no reliable numbers: the promise is sourced facts and tools to help you decide), what the site does, how every piece of info is checked, the site in numbers, the timeline, the project’s independence, who’s behind it, how to contribute, and a FAQ.

knowledge.q: Who’s behind Leonidakit?
knowledge.text: Leonidakit is made by a single player, in their free time, with no team or company: someone who wanted reliable numbers before release and built the site to share them. No name is published on the site; the publisher is identified on the Legal page (personal site) and answers through the Contact page.

knowledge.q: Is Leonidakit an official site?
knowledge.text: No. Leonidakit is a personal project, independent of Rockstar Games and Take-Two Interactive, free, with no account and no ads. The official images are credited in Media and credits. The official GTA VI website is rockstargames.com/VI.

knowledge.q: What do the statuses mean (official, seen in media, to be confirmed…)?
knowledge.text: Five statuses, always shown and linked to a dated source: Official (named or described by Rockstar), Seen in media (visible in a trailer, a screenshot or the Extended Look; price and purchase unknown), Community identification (a match made by players), Series benchmark (what GTA V or GTA Online do, never in the GTA VI column) and To be confirmed (nothing published: the row says what we’re waiting for).

knowledge.q: What’s a “series benchmark”?
knowledge.text: A “series benchmark” is what GTA V or GTA Online did, with their prices: a ballpark, never a GTA VI number. In the expandable lists, the GTA VI column stays “to be confirmed” as long as Rockstar hasn’t published anything. Example: full armor at $5,000 in GTA V.

knowledge.q: Does the site use leaks?
knowledge.text: No. The site refuses to publish anything that comes from leaks: a leak isn’t a source. Everything comes from Rockstar’s website and Newswire, the trailers, the Extended Look, official texts picked up by the press and official screenshots; GTA Wiki is only used for the series.

knowledge.q: How is a correction handled?
knowledge.text: You go through the Contact page with the page, the problem and the source. The fix goes into the site’s data, and the page is regenerated with its dated source. Content shows the date it was last checked.

knowledge.q: What counts as a good source for the site?
knowledge.text: A Rockstar page or video, or an official text picked up by a named outlet, with its date. A wiki is community-made; a leak isn’t a source. To suggest missing content: a precise name, its context, where it comes from, through the Contact page.

knowledge.q: How many pages, item pages and images does the site have?
knowledge.text: The “The site in numbers” section of the About page gives the counts recalculated at every regeneration: pages online, vehicle pages (302) and weapon pages (27), places on the map (2,547), rows in the expandable lists, credited official images, topics in my knowledge base, automated tests. No number is typed by hand.

knowledge.q: What will change on the site when GTA VI comes out?
knowledge.text: After release, real prices replace the series benchmarks, the lists fill in and missions are added to progress tracking. Every update is dated: a changelog for each version in the site’s repository, a date on every source. If the release date changes, the page changes with it.

knowledge.q: Is the site up to date? When was it checked?
knowledge.text: Every page shows its sources with the date they were accessed, and the About page gives the date of the latest sources opened and the date the release info was last reviewed. In my answers, the check date shows up when there is one.

knowledge.q: How do I contact Leonidakit?

The site’s email address is shown there, with a button to copy it. No response time is guaranteed.

knowledge.q: Where are the legal notice and privacy policy?
knowledge.text: The Legal and privacy page describes the publisher (an individual, on a non-professional basis), the host (Vercel), intellectual property, data (what stays in your browser, what gets sent and where, your rights), the lack of cookies, liability and accessibility.

knowledge.q: Does the site use cookies or ads?
knowledge.text: No: no cookies, no ads, no analytics and no scripts from other sites, checked in the code. The only exception, if you choose it: “Listen here”, on the Radio and music page, loads the official YouTube or Spotify player, which may then set its own cookies. Your calculations, your progress and your conversation with me stay in your browser, which is why there’s no banner to accept.

knowledge.q: Where is my data stored?
knowledge.text: In your browser: calculations, trackers, favorites, owned items, spotted places, markers and our conversation. Nothing is sent unless you submit a form: only Contact and the home page alert pass on what you write in them, through Brevo. You can export or erase everything from the Progress page.

knowledge.q: How do I get notified when the game comes out?
knowledge.text: At the bottom of the home page, an alert form (Brevo service) lets you leave your email address, with a checkbox to agree to receive the email. Your address is only used for this alert and stays with Brevo until you unsubscribe; the Legal and privacy page has all the details.

knowledge.q: Where do the site’s images come from?
knowledge.text: The images are screenshots, artwork and trailer stills published by Rockstar, cropped and credited one by one in Media and credits (148 images), with their source. The map photos come from gtadb.org (CC BY 4.0). No leaked images.

knowledge.q: How do I get around the site?
knowledge.text: The top bar gives you the Calculator, the Tutorial, the Map, Vehicles, the Armory, the Shop, Progress and the Explore menu (the world: places, characters, residences, safehouses, businesses, collectibles; gear up: consumables, clothing and style, customization; the site: About, Contact, Media and credits, Legal). The footer repeats everything. And you can ask me for a page: “open the residences”.

knowledge.q: How do I search for a page on the site?
knowledge.text: Search (the “A vehicle, a weapon, a place?” bar on the home page and on the section pages) searches the item pages, the categories, the site’s pages and the list rows; the map’s 2,500 places load on your first search. You can also give me a name: I’ll find the page.

knowledge.q: Does the site work on a phone?
knowledge.text: Yes: the site is tested from 320 to 1,920 px wide, on phone, tablet and computer. There’s no app: it’s a website, which you can add to your home screen if you want. Your progress stays on the device; export it to take it somewhere else.

knowledge.q: How do I turn off animations?
knowledge.text: The site follows the “reduce animations” setting (reduced motion) on your device or in your browser: everything shows at once, nothing moves, and the counters show their numbers right away. The calculator’s answers and my answers can be read right away.

knowledge.q: A page on the site no longer exists, what should I do?
knowledge.text: Some old addresses are redirected automatically (old weapon IDs, duplicate folders). If a page can’t be found, use the menu or search, and report the link on the Contact page.

knowledge.q: Can I print a page or a plan?
knowledge.text: Yes: the pages have a clean print style (no menu or buttons), and the sheet of a saved plan or calculation prints like a document from “My calculations”.

knowledge.q: How do I check off a vehicle I own?
knowledge.text: On the Vehicles page, check the “Garage” box on a card; on a page, use the “Add to my garage” button. The car goes into your garage. The garage bar counts your vehicles and offers “Open my garage”, “Share” and “Clear”. Everything stays saved on your device.

knowledge.q: Where can I see my garage?
knowledge.text: “Open my garage” opens the “My garage” page: the vehicles you own, your wishlist and the rest, with search, category filters, sorting and a link to each page. You can remove a vehicle there or add one.

knowledge.q: Where can I see my arsenal?
knowledge.text: “Open my arsenal” opens the “My arsenal” page: your weapons, your gear and your ammo types, with your wishlist and what’s left. For ammo, you can note your stock separately: the site never guesses a quantity.

knowledge.q: How do I share my garage or my arsenal?
knowledge.text: In the “My garage” bar (Vehicles) or the “My arsenal” bar (Armory), “Share” copies a link that holds the list of your checked IDs: whoever opens it sees those vehicles or weapons checked on their side (added to their own progress). “Clear” erases the list on this device, after you confirm. Nothing is sent to a server.

knowledge.q: Can I check off gear and ammo?
knowledge.text: Yes: in the Armory, the 16 pieces of gear and gadgets and the 5 ammo types can be checked just like weapons, with a “My gear” bar. They’re in your “My arsenal” tracker, included in “All my progress”.

knowledge.q: What’s on the Progress page?
knowledge.text: One tracker per family: My garage, My arsenal, My wardrobe, My consumables, My customizations, My properties and content, My spotted places, My collectibles, My calculations and plans. Each card counts what’s checked and leads to the tracker’s page. An “All my progress” counter sums them up; it’s not the game’s official progress.

knowledge.q: How do I export or import my progress?
knowledge.text: On the Progress page, “Export my progress” creates a file with your garage, arsenal, spotted places, checked content, saved calculator calculations, and map markers and drawings. On the other device, import the file: a preview shows what’s in it, then “Merge” adds its checkboxes to yours and “Replace” puts the file in their place, section by section.

knowledge.q: How do I delete my data on the site?
knowledge.text: Each list has its own button (“Clear” for the garage and the arsenal, “Uncheck all” on the map, “Delete” in the trackers), and clearing the site’s data in your browser removes everything. Export your progress first if you want to keep it.

knowledge.q: Does the tracking read my console save?
knowledge.text: No. Progress tracking doesn’t read any console save and doesn’t connect to any account: you’re the one who checks what you have. It’s not the game’s completion percentage.

knowledge.q: How do I check off a consumable, a hairstyle or a tattoo?
knowledge.text: In each expandable list (Consumables, Clothing and style, Customization), a row’s “I have it” box adds it to your progress: the list’s bar goes up, and the family’s tracker files it (My consumables, My wardrobe, My customizations). A row linked to a Rockstar card shares its checkbox, counted once.

knowledge.q: Léo, do you send my questions anywhere?

knowledge.q: How do I clear the conversation with Léo?
knowledge.text: Click “Clear” at the top of the panel: the conversation in this tab disappears. It also clears itself after 30 minutes without activity, and it’s never shared between tabs or sent anywhere else.

knowledge.q: Léo, do you understand abbreviations and typos?
knowledge.text: Yes: I know a list of abbreviations and casual words (gta6, vc, ultim…), and I can handle typos and close misspellings. If I get it wrong, rephrase with a specific name or use “Report a wrong answer”.

knowledge.q: How do I report a wrong answer from Léo?
knowledge.text: Under each answer, “Report a wrong answer” opens the Contact page with your question and my answer already filled in: you add what’s wrong and, if you can, a source. The fix then goes into the site’s data.

knowledge.q: Léo, can you open the map on a place?
knowledge.text: Yes: ask “where is Vice City” or “show Rideout Customs on the map” and I’ll give you a link that centers the map on the marker. For a place the site doesn’t know, I tell you I don’t have it.

knowledge.q: Léo, can you do a calculation?
knowledge.text: Yes: type your numbers in one sentence (“I have 200k and I’m aiming for 1 million”, “I have 45 min tonight”, “I want to buy a Kamacho for 150k”) and I’ll set up the right tool with the values I understood, which you can fix before opening the calculator. The calculation itself happens in the tool, with the same engine.

knowledge.q: Léo, do you know everything about GTA VI?
knowledge.text: No: I only say what the site knows, with a link to the page it comes from. For anything Rockstar hasn’t published (in-game prices, length, online mode…), I say so clearly and point you to the official site. I also don’t answer questions outside GTA VI and Leonidakit.

knowledge.q: What do a list’s badges and legend mean?

Esc, the X or a click outside closes it, and focus goes back to the button. On a phone, it takes up the whole screen, and the X stays visible.
